Show or change how each category of notices reaches you, and their language. Without flags it shows
them. Billing, legal and security notices always reach you.

Usage:
  voidhash notices preferences [flags]

Flags:
      --category <billing|legal|security|account|integrations|product>
                        The category to change, with --inbox or --email
      --email <on|off>  Whether its notices are emailed to you
  -h, --help            Show help for this command
      --inbox <on|off>  Whether its notices appear in your inbox
      --json            Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --locale <en|cs>  The language of your notices, in every organization
      --org <org>       Organization to act on: its slug, name or id (default: the organization of
                        this directory's or your default project)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash notices preferences
  voidhash notices preferences --category product --email off
  voidhash notices preferences --locale cs
